note: Operator rulings on the 6 disputed pairs, by pooled blind id, each made after viewing its composite and before looking up which set it came from. The per-set operator.json files are what `evals:consistency report --operator` reads.

c041.notes: Viewed: a bare plank table before a plain clapboard house on the left; a long cloth-covered table before a tall ornate gabled house on the right.

c047.notes: Viewed: the dripping man by the fire has dark curly hair and a greying beard; the diving Peter is clearly grey-haired and older.

c070.notes: Viewed: the left shows the shore at night with the sea still unparted, so there is no path to compare with the right.

c023.notes: Viewed: the same stormy lake under the same hills, in a single-masted plank boat; only the sternpost differs (plain against scrolled).

c072.notes: Viewed: the same lake and hills, storm on the left and the calm the text asks for on the right; the sternpost differs but the place does not.

c083.notes: Viewed: both show the sandy seabed path between walls of water below red desert bluffs; the night storm on the right is the change the text asks for.
